**Analyzing Grid Orientations**

I'm now focusing on the grid orientations, specifically the changed 2s to 3s and their spatial relationship. Initial observations from the first training example reveal shapes with a border of four (yellow) and specific vertical orientation of 2s in the left shape. The right shape also appears to have a distinct pattern, and I'm examining its specifics.


**Identifying Horizontal Transformations**

I've zeroed in on the transformations. Horizontal lines of 2s, in all the examples, morph into 3s, irrespective of the encompassing shape. Conversely, vertical lines of 2s retain their original value, which is very revealing. I'm wondering if a single 2 becomes a 3 as well if presented horizontally or vertically. I'm investigating those scenarios now.
